topicName: The Nature and Purpose of Families

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Both Christianity and Islam see the family as the basic unit of society. Families provide stability, love, education and the passing on of faith to the next generation.

steps.title: RS Exam Tips — The Nature and Purpose of Families
steps.body: 1. For The Nature and Purpose of Families questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. steps.title: UK Context

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always refer to specific sources of authority (scripture, sacred texts, religious leaders) Explain contrasting beliefs — different views within and between traditions Use key terminology precisely (e.g. tawhid, atonement, sanctity of life) For 12-mark evaluation questions, consider both sides before reaching a justified conclusion Link beliefs to their impact on individuals, communities and society Acknowledge diversity — no religious tradition has a single, uniform view
